items.body_html: a workflow may declare runtime_context = none — then START needs no provider, sets ready(∅), and the packet carries runtime_context: none; readiness still gates dispatch only when a context is required
the RuntimeContextRequirement lives on the pinned template (single source of truth), not snapshotted into instance state — a run-override cascade is possible later, same shape as AgentConfig (L0c)
when a context is required, an unknown spec.provider → Rejected(runtime_context_provider_unavailable) before any provisioning; deeper health/availability is deferred
a provider may only return a ref whose kind = the requested spec kind; the kernel guards kind + correlation and treats the locator as opaque (provider-defined, not validated)
the packet carries either runtime_context: none or only project_for_actor(ref), resolved through the same pinned-template provider that issued the request — the raw ref stays kernel-side
a provider used by an active instance stays resolvable for the life of the run (pinned spec); dispatch REQUIREs it as a kernel/config invariant, not a business rejection
